# Project Guidelines

## Project Context
Before doing any work in this repo, read `project_context.md` at the repo root — it is the single source of truth for this SQL portfolio project's business rules, data model, synthetic data generation plan, and scope decisions. Keep it updated whenever new decisions are made or scope changes.

## Guardrails
- Don't write SQL queries in `sql/` for the user — they are writing those themselves to demonstrate their skills.
- Don't write entire Python scripts from scratch for the user (including synthetic data generation scripts, helper modules, or database creation scripts). The user wants to write those themselves to learn implementation details.
- It is okay to assist with small portions, snippets, or tedious data structures (e.g., product dictionaries, syntax fixes, or specific logic blocks) to help the user move faster, as long as you do not generate an entire script.
- Help with framework/scaffolding: folder structure, README, conceptual guidance, and partial code assistance as requested.
- When explaining Python or SQL concepts, keep the guidance educational and encourage the user to implement the code themselves.
